name: HEAP_ALLOC_MAGIC
meaning: Written at block+4 on allocation (0x54df1f, 0x54e2d8); the only two occurrences in the image. Never compared.

name: HEAP_MIN_SPLIT
meaning: A free block is split only if at least 24 bytes would remain; otherwise the caller gets the whole block.

name: HEAP_SENTINEL_SIZE
meaning: Size of the permanent end block.

name: HEAP_HEADER_SIZE
meaning: Header bytes before the user pointer; also the minimum payload size.

name: HEAP_SMALLPOOL_THRESHOLD
meaning: Heap_Init sets up small pools only when the arena is larger than this.
